facts.fact: Blip states that it is trusted by over 200,000 independent businesses and advertisers.
facts.quote: Trusted by over 200,000 independent businesses and advertisers

facts.fact: Blip's stated process for launching a billboard campaign has four steps: choose locations, set budget and schedule, upload design, and get approved.
Blip states that it reviews and approves all designs with its Sign Partners before campaigns go live.
facts.quote: We review and approve all designs with our Sign Partners to ensure they’re ready for action.

facts.fact: Blip states that approved billboard campaigns are up and running immediately after approval.
facts.quote: From there, they’re up and running immediately so you see results ASAP.

facts.fact: Blip states that its digital billboard advertising is available on any budget, with campaigns set by choosing locations, schedule, spend amount, and uploading artwork.
facts.quote: Now digital billboard advertising is available on any budget.
